_meta.purpose: Registry of Jackrabbit-Class competitor orgs tracked by FOFNIntel. Replaces the hardcoded ENTITIES bash array in .github/workflows/refresh-barron.yml.
_meta.source: Location universe derived from report-sandbox html/marketing/local-market-analysis/data/lma_competitor_geo_source.csv (Jackrabbit brands only) joined to lma_competitor_sites.csv for BBSS proximity.
_meta.key_concept: One Jackrabbit ORG = one parent account. An org can cover many physical locations, selected at extract time with --loc-filter. Never create one account per location.

credential_model.store: single GitHub Actions secret JR_ACCOUNTS holding a JSON object keyed by org_id
credential_model.alias_convention: cjfogerty+<account_key>@gmail.com  -- real deliverable mailbox, one alias per org so a single org lockout cannot cascade
credential_model.note: This file holds NO credentials. account.alias is the address to use; the password lives only in the secret.

status_values.live: account exists, extractor runs, dashboard published
status_values.unlocked: an existing account already covers this location; only needs a workflow entry + --loc-filter. NO new signup required.
status_values.needs_org_id: location confirmed in LMA but the Jackrabbit OrgID is not yet discovered
status_values.needs_account: OrgID known, no parent account yet

org_id_discovery.method: VALIDATED 2026-08-29. Every British franchise territory page at britishswimschool.com/<territory-slug>/ carries a Parent Portal link in its nav of the form app.jackrabbitclass.com/jr3.0/ParentPortal/Login?orgId=<OrgID>. One page fetch yields the OrgID AND the territory's full pool list. Entirely public -- no account required to discover any of this.
org_id_discovery.validation: Confirmed against san-diego-temecula-valley, which returned 548999 -- matching the OrgID in the regv2.asp registration link Casey already had.
org_id_discovery.territory_index: britishswimschool.com/locations/us/ lists every territory slug, but it is long enough that WebFetch truncates it mid-Illinois. Needs Chrome or curl to enumerate slugs beyond that point.
org_id_discovery.warning: Territory membership does NOT follow geography. The San Diego org covers pools up in Irvine. Always take membership from the territory page's own pool list, never from distance clustering.
org_id_discovery.loc_codes: The per-location Loc code (e.g. 24KM = 24 Hour Fitness Kearny Mesa) appears in regv2.asp registration links and in the portal's location dropdown; resolve at extract time.

extraction.method: PUBLIC Jackrabbit OpeningsJS feed -- no parent account required. app.jackrabbitclass.com/jr3.0/Openings/OpeningsJS?OrgID=<org>&loc=<code>. Verified HTTP 200 with data on all 13 orgs tried 2026-08-29. GetClassesForEnroll still 302s to login, but is not needed.
extraction.supersedes: The authenticated Playwright login in barron_extract.py and the whole per-org parent-account plan this registry was built for.
extraction.caveat: enrolled is DERIVED (capacity is not published). Validated against the authenticated Bear Paddle Bloomingdale dashboard: 383 derived vs 369 actual (+3.8%), utilization 78.5% vs 78.8% (-0.3pp). Biased slightly high.
extraction.location_splitting: British encodes the site in the class name (Starfish - 24KM - 3 Tue) so an org feed splits locally. Bear Paddle does NOT -- generic class names, no location column -- so each site needs its own &loc= code. Unknown codes return a clean empty table, so probing is safe.
